headline: Did Rákay Philip’s Company Know in Advance About Hankook’s Giga Investment? Police Already Investigating
summary: A complaint was filed over a land deal at Rácalmás in which a company linked to Rákay Philip earned HUF 1.4 billion around the Hankook Tire factory expansion. Police are investigating.
why: Hankook Tire is a South Korean tyre maker, and its Hungarian plant expansion is a significant investment in the local industrial sector.
